title: cyclamen africanum subsp. saldense
intro: Cyclamen africanum subsp. saldense, commonly known as the African cyclamen or Salzmann's cyclamen, is a rare and endemic species of flowering plant in the genus Cyclamen. This plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cyclamen africanum subsp. saldense include its use as a diuretic and its potential to lower blood pressure, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as aucubin and isobutylamides, which have been shown to have potential therapeutic properties in traditional medicine.
